text: {"lessons":["My account is worth more than at the start, but month-to-month moves—including a 3.5% drop—show that gains are not guaranteed and can reverse.","Because I depend on these savings in retirement, I should prioritize manageable risk and avoid impulsive trades in response to one month's change.","I have made no trades, so I should deliberately review my holdings and cash against my living needs rather than assume my current mix is suitable."]}
